## Highlights

Steno 0.15 makes newly scaffolded sites easier to run: the initializer creates working build and
development tasks, handles existing Deno configuration, and checks local theme paths before writing
project files.

## Themes and templates

- New projects can use an existing local theme inside the project directory. The initializer reports
  a missing or outside-project path before creating site files.
- Official themes now declare version 0.15.0 and depend on `@steno/steno@^0.15.0`.

## Development and scaffolding

- Generated `deno task build` and `deno task dev` commands use the selected content directory and
  run through the generated project's Steno dependency.
- Existing `deno.json` and `deno.jsonc` files are preserved. When one exists, the initializer prints
  direct build and development commands instead of replacing the configuration.
- The CLI validates dev ports, accepts `--no-short-urls`, and documents the `--` separator needed to
  pass flags through `deno create`.

## Packages and API stability

- `@steno/init` is 0.15.0 and generates projects pinned to Steno and official themes `^0.15.0` by
  default. Steno is 0.15.0; Core remains at 0.2.0 and Tau remains at 0.9.0.

## Release confidence

- Init coverage now exercises the CLI and generated build task with each official theme and a local
  theme, including custom paths and short URL settings ([#320](https://github.com/stenopress/steno/pull/320)).
- Added regression coverage for existing Deno configuration, local theme errors, and scaffolded
  commands ([#320](https://github.com/stenopress/steno/pull/320)).

## Dependencies

- Updated the first-party release graph to Steno, init, and official themes 0.15.0. Core remains at
  0.2.0, Tau remains at 0.9.0, and `marked` remains at 18.0.11.
